<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

class DocumentImportController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Import XML document for processing.
     * Supports SOAP envelope format and raw XML payloads.
     */
    public function import(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'xml_content' => 'required|string',
            'format' => 'nullable|in:soap,raw,rss',
        ]);

        $xmlContent = $request->input('xml_content');
        $format = $request->input('format', 'raw');

        try {
            $result = $this->parseXmlDocument($xmlContent, $format);
            return response()->json([
                'status' => 'success',
                'data' => $result,
                'imported_at' => now()->toISOString(),
            ]);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            Log::error('XML import failed', [
                'error' => $e->getMessage(),
                'format' => $format,
            ]);
            return response()->json([
                'status' => 'error',
                'message' => 'Failed to parse XML document: ' . $e->getMessage(),
            ], 422);
        }
    }

    private function parseXmlDocument(string $xmlContent, string $format): array
    {
        // Note: libxml_disable_entity_loader is deprecated in PHP 8.0+
        // We rely on application-level validation instead
        $previousValue = libxml_use_internal_errors(true);

        $doc = new \DOMDocument('1.0', 'UTF-8');
        $doc->resolveExternals = true;
        $doc->substituteEntities = true;

        if (!$doc->loadXML($xmlContent, LIBXML_NONET | LIBXML_DTDLOAD)) {
            $errors = libxml_get_errors();
            libxml_clear_errors();
            libxml_use_internal_errors($previousValue);
            throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid XML: ' . ($errors[0]->message ?? 'unknown error'));
        }

        libxml_use_internal_errors($previousValue);

        return $this->extractData($doc, $format);
    }

    private function extractData(\DOMDocument $doc, string $format): array
    {
        $xpath = new \DOMXPath($doc);
        $result = [];

        switch ($format) {
            case 'soap':
                $xpath->registerNamespace('soap', 'http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/');
                $bodies = $xpath->query('//soap:Body/*');
                foreach ($bodies as $node) {
                    $result[] = $this->nodeToArray($node);
                }
                break;

            case 'rss':
                $items = $xpath->query('//item');
                foreach ($items as $item) {
                    $result[] = [
                        'title' => $xpath->evaluate('string(title)', $item),
                        'description' => $xpath->evaluate('string(description)', $item),
                        'link' => $xpath->evaluate('string(link)', $item),
                    ];
                }
                break;

            default:
                $root = $doc->documentElement;
                if ($root) {
                    $result = $this->nodeToArray($root);
                }
                break;
        }

        return $result;
    }

    private function nodeToArray(\DOMNode $node): array
    {
        $result = [];
        if ($node->hasChildNodes()) {
            foreach ($node->childNodes as $child) {
                if ($child->nodeType === XML_ELEMENT_NODE) {
                    $result[$child->nodeName] = $child->textContent;
                } elseif ($child->nodeType === XML_TEXT_NODE && trim($child->textContent) !== '') {
                    $result['_value'] = trim($child->textContent);
                }
            }
        }
        return $result;
    }
}
